vectors.description: LOC-02 gives 0x06 two meanings: Timestamp (2.3.1.1 and Table 1 in 6.1) and Audio Level (2.3.3.1), so the value is not interpreted, even though 1746104606044000 is a wall-clock Timestamp in size.
LOC-02 gives 0x06 two meanings: Timestamp (2.3.1.1 and Table 1 in 6.1) and Audio Level (2.3.3.1), so the value is not interpreted, even though 127 fits the Audio Level octet.
